text: Pharmacopoeias. In Chin as synthetic borneol (Borneolum Syntheticum). Profile Borneol is a constituent of several essential oils. It has antiseptic and antispasmodic actions and is included in preparations for the treatment of biliary- and urinary-tract disorders.
